spec.title: go-discord-caller
spec.description: Discord voice relay system. Metrics exported via OpenTelemetry OTLP gRPC. OTel→Prometheus naming: dots→underscores, unit suffixes appended (_seconds, _milliseconds).

spec.title: Pipeline Latency P99
spec.description: End-to-end audio relay latency at 99th percentile

spec.title: Mixer Tick P99
spec.description: Mixer 20ms tick processing time at 99th percentile

spec.title: Mixer Tick Duration P50 / P95 / P99
spec.description: Time to process one 20 ms audio mixing tick. Budget: 20 ms. Values above threshold indicate the mixer is falling behind real-time.

spec.title: Pipeline End-to-End Latency P50 / P95 / P99
spec.description: Time from fanout decode (VoiceReceiver) to mixer output frame. Measures the full audio relay delay introduced by the mixing pipeline.

spec.title: Active Voice Callers
spec.description: Users with the caller role currently in a voice channel, per guild

spec.title: Voice Callers Over Time
spec.description: Users with the caller role in a voice channel, per guild

spec.title: Gateway Latency (avg)
spec.description: Average Discord gateway WebSocket heartbeat RTT across all bots

spec.title: Bot Gateway Latency
spec.description: Discord gateway WebSocket heartbeat RTT per bot

spec.title: Bots Online per Guild
spec.description: 1 when a bot is a registered member of the guild; emitted only for bots present in the guild
